name: Tome of Divinity
label: Quest
description: Tome of Divinity marks a vital summons for budding human paladins serving the Alliance. Dispatched by local mentors like Brother Wilhelm in Goldshire…
intro: Tome of Divinity marks a vital summons for budding human paladins serving the Alliance. Dispatched by local mentors like Brother Wilhelm in Goldshire, initiates travel to Stormwind's Cathedral of Light to meet Duthorian Rall. Answering this call begins the sacred trial necessary to master the holy gift of resurrection.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Greetings, friend. Duthorian Rall, one of our most influential paladins, was speaking about you recently. I overheard him talking about how it was time you be put to the test some... Along with some very complimentary things about how well you've performed thus far.
If I were you, I'd head to Stormwind and speak to him when you have time. I'm sure he's in the Cathedral of Light--that's where he spends most of his time.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is beautiful here in Stormwind, is it not?
Your timing actually couldn't have been better, friend.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
